description: This file implements overlay hardware abstraction layer (HAL) for Samsung Crespo device, including control and data modules for overlay management, buffer handling, and interaction with V4L2 and framebuffer.

classes.name: overlay_object
classes.description: Represents an overlay instance, encapsulating handle, control, staging, and shared data.

classes.name: handle_t
classes.description: Custom handle structure extending native_handle, containing file descriptors and overlay parameters.

methods.name: create_shared_data
methods.description: Creates shared overlay data region with mutex for inter-process synchronization.

methods.name: destroy_shared_data
methods.description: Destroys shared overlay data, releases mutex, unmaps memory, and closes file descriptor.

methods.name: open_shared_data
methods.description: Maps shared overlay data region into process address space, increments reference count.

methods.name: close_shared_data
methods.description: Unmaps shared overlay data and decrements reference count.

methods.name: enable_streaming_locked
methods.description: Enables overlay streaming if control and data are ready, calls v4l2 overlay stream on.

methods.name: disable_streaming_locked
methods.description: Disables overlay streaming if currently enabled, calls v4l2 overlay stream off.

methods.name: set_color_space
methods.description: Sets V4L2 pixel format based on overlay format.

methods.name: overlay_get
methods.description: Retrieves overlay capabilities such as min/max scaling, rotation steps, and alignment.

methods.name: get_fb_var_screeninfo
methods.description: Fetches framebuffer variable screen info to determine display resolution and color depth.

methods.name: overlay_createOverlay
methods.description: Creates and initializes overlay, sets up shared data, configures FIMC parameters, and opens V4L2 overlay device.

methods.name: overlay_destroyOverlay
methods.description: Destroys overlay, disables streaming, releases shared data, and closes device.

methods.name: overlay_setPosition
methods.description: Sets overlay position and size, ensuring within display bounds.

methods.name: overlay_getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves current overlay position and size.

methods.name: overlay_setParameter
methods.description: Sets overlay parameters such as rotation and flip.

methods.name: overlay_stage
methods.description: Prepares overlay for commit (no operation here).

methods.name: overlay_commit
methods.description: Applies staged overlay parameters, updates FIMC, and manages streaming state.

methods.name: overlay_control_close
methods.description: Closes overlay control device, destroys overlay instance, and frees resources.

methods.name: overlay_device_open
methods.description: Opens overlay control or data device, initializes state, and assigns function pointers.
